- AWS: a test IAM role with programmatic access and a sample request pattern (we'll run a lightweight probe against your SaaS endpoints to validate meter emission).
- Azure: an app registration in your Azure AD with delegated consent so we can validate offer provisioning flows.
- Expected traffic profile: 50–100 requests/min for a 1-hour window during the test.

I've attached a sample sku_mapping.csv and two scripts (meter_probe.py, azure_provision.sh) in the Drive link (see related links). If you prefer, we can run the first pass in our sandbox environment and send logs for your review. 

Security note: do not send production credentials over email. Use the Secure Share link in my signature.

- Kevin/Sophie: confirm availability for Wed 11/25 10:00 PST or Thu 11/26 14:00 PST.
- Laura: once metering is validated, please send the draft publisher agreement for signature (we'll accept DocuSign).
